coverage.unresolved: All between-sample native intersections; all overlapping native component pairs with no positive witness; mechanical own-vehicle joints outside scoped interfaces.

method.positive_penetration: At most 12 deterministically strided native triangle inward centroid probes per connected component/direction in both whole original meshes, absolute solid angle >2pi and both closest-surface depths >2um. Every disconnected solid retained in whole winding/depth; components prune only.
method.broadphase: All canonical fixed entities, original source/target storage included; entity and native component AABBs only prune. Native no-witness pairs explicitly unresolved.
method.instance_transform: Only existing selected HU Float32 instance slots updated relative to unchanged accepted integer mesh origins and sourceMatrix.
method.driver: Original F02 WorkerInstance bound once via existing bindSeatedDriver, absolute reset and actual world anchor observations at each pose.
method.identity: Deterministically seeded Three UUID allocation for reproducible CPU report; actual same allocated UUIDs and Float32 indices checked across seeks and reset.
method.provenance: Read-only algorithm patterns copied from pinned check_holder_scene_clearance.mjs; never imported or executed.

root_decision: Root alone decides PASS/FIX; native runtime/browser integration remains open.
